title: The active ransomware event — question explanation
learningObjective: Prioritize isolation and incident escalation without destroying evidence or improvising recovery
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A workstation displays a ransom note, and several shared files are becoming inaccessible. The user asks whether to reboot the machine and delete the note.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Prioritize isolation and incident escalation without destroying evidence or improvising recovery
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option A: Isolate affected systems in a coordinated manner, activate the response plan and preserve evidence; follow recovery guidance from authorized responders. Containment is urgent, but should be coordinated; evidence and recovery decisions must be handled through incident response.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option B: Connecting removable media to a potentially infected machine may expose backups to compromise. Option C: Uncoordinated rebooting may destroy volatile evidence and does not reliably stop propagation. Option D: Deleting evidence is harmful, and payment is not a reliable recovery strategy or unilateral user decision.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Activate the incident-response process, isolate affected systems as directed, protect clean backups, preserve evidence and involve system owners and authorities as appropriate. Contain ransomware safely and coordinate response; do not improvise recovery or destroy evidence.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Contain ransomware safely and coordinate response; do not improvise recovery or destroy evidence.
